data.title: Axe hangs over Australian batters after Darwin 'disaster'
data.description: DARWIN, Australia - Australia's humiliating nine-wicket loss to Bangladesh has accelerated calls for regeneration of its ageing Test team with opener Jake Weatherald and the inconsistent Marnus Labuschagne in the firing line.

data.title: ONE Championship: Chatri predicts ‘biggest year in history’ as 2027 expansion takes shape
data.description: ONE Championship chairman and CEO Chatri Sityodtong has predicted 2027 will be the biggest year in the promotion’s history, promising more major events in Qatar and teasing further international expansion.

data.title: Winning back walls from gangs, artists fill El Salvador's towns with colour
data.description: CONCEPCION DE ATACO (EL SALVADOR) - On the walls where gang members in El Salvador once marked their turf, urban artists are now creating large murals in a traveling festival that fills the streets of the Central American country with colour.

data.title: ONE Championship: Stella Hemetsberger ‘feeling good in the gold’ as kickboxing defence beckons
data.description: Stella Hemetsberger suggested a defence of her ONE Championship strawweight kickboxing title will “probably” come next after stopping Natalia Diachkova in Bangkok.

data.title: THAI, VitalLife and Bumrungrad Partner on Wellness-Focused In-Flight Entertainment
data.description: Thai Airways International Public Co Ltd (THAI), VitalLife Scientific Wellness Center, and Bumrungrad International Hospital have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to collaborate on the development of a new generation of in-flight entertainment (IFE) content that integrates travel, lifestyle and health knowledge. The initiative aims to enhance the onboard experience by inspiring passengers to embrace healthier lifestyles while showcasing Thailand’s unique destinations through a fresh wellness perspective.

data.title: Photos, memories all that remain for Colombia's bereaved after quake
data.description: CALI (COLOMBIA) - In Torres del Limonar, a Cali residential complex that collapsed in Monday's earthquake, people pick through rubble to recover victims' belongings and return them to grieving families.

data.title: Sabbath cafe clash lays bare Israel faultlines
data.description: JERUSALEM - Alma Ronen has been fighting in the Israeli military nearly constantly for more than two years. Spending her Saturday not in uniform but in a T-shirt and jeans, she would like to enjoy a coffee outside -- and resents that her more religious compatriots think otherwise.

data.title: As machinery removes rubble, hopes for survivors from Colombian quake dwindle
data.description: CALI (COLOMBIA) - The noise of backhoes, cranes and bulldozers echoed across Colombia's quake-hit cities on Sunday as workers labored to remove rubble, though the chance of finding survivors was slim a week after the disaster.

data.title: Nearly 13,000 displaced by deadly Indonesian quake
data.description: MBAY, Indonesia - Thousands of people displaced by a powerful earthquake in eastern Indonesia awaited much-needed aid on Monday as they camped out at schools, police stations and government offices, with many stuck outside.

data.title: 'ABAC Connext' focuses on the  future of university education
data.description: <p>Assumption University (ABAC) invites parents, secondary school students and prospective university applicants to explore the future of education and employment during "ABAC Connext 2026", at SCBX Next Tech, 4th floor of Siam Paragon, on Saturday from 10am to 8pm.</p>

data.title: Govt confident in maritime border talks
data.description: <p>Thailand is confident the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (Unclos) conciliation process over its maritime boundary dispute with Cambodia will proceed smoothly after Australian diplomat Katrina Cooper was appointed as the fifth conciliator and chair of the Conciliation Commission.</p>

data.title: Ministry seeks nod for  southern double-track plan
data.description: <p>The Transport Ministry will seek cabinet approval next month for a 106.8-billion-baht plan to build about 504 kilometres of double-track railway from Chumphon to the Malaysian border.</p>

data.title: NHSO faces gold card reform calls
data.description: <p>For more than 20 years, Thailand's universal healthcare scheme has stood as one of the country's most significant social welfare achievements, providing medical care for almost 50 million people.</p>

data.title: Thailand Positions THECA 2026 as Asia's Hub for Electronics, AI & Mobility
data.description: As artificial intelligence (AI), datacentres, cloud computing, electricvehiclesand smart manufacturing continue to reshape the global economy, demand for advanced electronics, semiconductors and next-generation manufacturing technologies is growing at an unprecedented pace.

data.title: BICT Fest 2026 celebrates the power of “PLAY”
data.description: Attention please! BICT Fest, the 5th Bangkok International Children’s Theatre Festival, is back from Aug 21 to 30, 2026.

data.title: Karon a 'model area' for landslide risk assessment
data.description: <p>Phuket: Tambon Karon in Muang district of this resort province, where a major landslide in August 2024 killed 13 people, has been selected as a model area for assessing landslide risks and developing measures to protect residents, tourists and critical infrastructure.</p>

data.title: Trump says US scaling back military drills with South Korea
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump said he was "not happy" about US participation in joint military exercises with close ally South Korea and is scaling back the drills aimed at deterring rival North Korea that start Monday.

data.title: BMA pushes strict alcohol regulations
data.description: <p>The Thai Health Promotion Foundation (ThaiHealth) and Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) are stepping up efforts to raise public awareness of stricter alcohol controls, urging retailers and communities to help prevent sales to people under 20 and those who are visibly intoxicated.</p>

data.title: It's advantage Thailand in Asean semi
data.description: <p>Thailand took a decisive step towards the Asean Hyundai Cup final as striker Teerasak Poeiphimai struck twice in the opening half to secure a 3-1 away win over Singapore on Saturday night.</p>

data.title: Kunlavut begins bid to reclaim world title
data.description: <p>Former champion Kunlavut Vitidsarn will face Viren Nettasinghe of Sri Lanka in the first round of the BWF World Championships as 18 Thai players will compete in all five categories of the 2026 tournament, beginning today in New Delhi.</p>

data.title: BJT demands proof of poll fraud claims
data.description: <p>The Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) is unfazed by the opposition's planned no-confidence debate, saying allegations of fraud in the Senate election must be backed by evidence.</p>

data.title: New school design  'can limit casualties'
data.description: <p>A Thammasat University study has proposed changes to school buildings and grounds that it says could help reduce casualties in mass shootings by slowing attackers and giving students and staff more time to escape or take shelter.</p>

data.title: Thailand eyes Dawei port role
data.description: <p>Thailand is positioning itself as a key player in the proposed Dawei deep-sea port project in Myanmar, as Russia expresses interest in investing in major infrastructure projects in the region, including the long-delayed port.</p>

data.title: Hopes pinned on Si Sa Ket wat
data.description: <p>Si Sa Ket, a relatively low-profile tourist destination, is being positioned for greater attention through a tourism push centred on cultural, spiritual and natural attractions.</p>
